Why Choose Us

Ceramic Coating Built for Arizona's Climate

Arizona's intense sun and heat are brutal on paint. Jay's ceramic coatings are selected specifically for the Arizona climate — providing UV protection, heat resistance, and hydrophobic properties that keep your car cleaner longer.

Mobile service across Arizona — Jay comes to your home, office, or anywhere that works for you.
